title: ELITE PLATES NAME THE AFFIX
why: The small badge over an elite machine head sat right where its nameplate is drawn, so the plate covered it. The plate now carries the word itself (SHIELDED, VOLATILE, FAST or MENDER) in the colour of the outline, and the badge is gone, so one mark says it instead of two on top of each other.
now: An elite machine nameplate now names its affix in its colour, and the covered badge is gone.

edits.replacement: // v26.xx (aip2): no badge here any more, the nameplate names the affix (AFFIX_WORD)

: ne.name+(ne.state==='extract'?' [RUNNING]':(ne._plateTag||''))+((ne.elite&&ne.affix&&AFFIX_WORD[ne.affix])?'  '+AFFIX_WORD[ne.affix]:'');   // v26.xx (aip2): an affixed elite machine says what it is, in its colour (drawn below)

edits.anchor: wc.fillText(plate,ne.x-tw/2,ne.y-lift);   // v8.39: inside its plate, not off the right of it
